QUICK ANSWER

Who is this custom camo rash guard for?

This short-sleeve camo rash guard direction suits BJJ academies, MMA gyms and private-label brands developing graphic-led No-Gi training collections. Define compression fit, sleeve and body measurements, seam construction and authorized artwork together. Confirm the material, opacity, stretch recovery, print and labels through physical sampling before placing a bulk order.

Compare front, side and back fit references

Inspect the seam, collar and logo placement

The images show visible panel joins and artwork placement. They do not establish a laboratory result, stitch count or universal material specification.

Build the specification around your training use

Compression-knit selection

Compare stretch, recovery, hand feel and opacity on the intended fit. Confirm the fiber blend and GSM against the approved swatch; the example 85/15 blend and 220–250 GSM range are not specifications established for this product.

Raglan and seam approval

Check reaching, rotation and grounded movement. Agree chest, body and sleeve measurements, tolerances, collar finish and seam configuration before approving the sample.

Custom sublimation artwork

Develop compatible panel artwork, team colors and private labels. Inspect alignment, stretch appearance and agreed wash checks; no permanent fade-proof or zero-chafing guarantee is implied.

Tactical camo rash guard design video

Generated design presentation · About 15 seconds. This is not a physical performance or durability test. Approve the real sample before bulk production.

Artwork and branding reference

This page does not claim a licensed partnership, ownership of third-party patterns or permission to reproduce third-party branding. For your own project, specify your original or authorized artwork and confirm its use before sampling.

Use the garment reference to discuss silhouette, panel layout and desired artwork areas. Final branding and production artwork are approved separately.

Custom camo rash guard buyer questions

Can TONTON develop custom camo rash guards with our brand artwork?

Yes. Send your authorized artwork, preferred colors, logo map, sleeve direction and quantities by size. Confirm panel alignment, print color, private labels and packaging on the approved sample.

Does this page establish an official KRYPTEK collaboration?

No affiliation or licensing claim is made. Supplied reference images contain existing third-party marks and pattern names. Your order uses the artwork and rights approved for that project; the reference does not establish permission to reproduce third-party branding.

What fabric composition and GSM does this reference use?

Confirm the selected compression-knit swatch, fiber composition, GSM, stretch recovery and opacity during quotation and sampling. No exact blend or weight is established for this reference by the supplied images.

Are the seams four-needle six-thread flatlock?

The references show contrasting black seam lines and raglan panel joins. Request the four-needle six-thread flatlock direction if required, then confirm the actual stitch construction and skin-side finish on the physical sample.

Can this camo rash guard be used in No-Gi competition?

It is presented as a training and custom-development reference. Check the relevant event, rank, division and date before approving colors, graphics and coverage for competition. No blanket competition approval is claimed.

What are the MOQ, size range and sample timing?

Selected projects start from 10 pieces. Confirm minimums per style, design and colorway, the size chart and quantity allocation. The selected-project sample target is 3–7 days after usable artwork and details are confirmed; sourcing and revisions can change the schedule.
